title: Which terms land on this power?
hook: Several pairs of coefficients can meet at the same output degree.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
Binary masks, basic complex arithmetic for FFT, polynomial coefficients.
doesNotKnow: Multiply polynomials by aligning coefficient pairs whose indices sum to the output index.

misconception: Multiplying polynomial coefficient arrays means multiplying matching indices only.
objective: Multiply polynomials by aligning coefficient pairs whose indices sum to the output index.

claims.text: A product term’s degree is the sum of its input degrees. Contributions add into exactly that aligned output cell, so several pairs can contribute to one coefficient. This operation uses index addition, unlike an XOR convolution.
